requirements.requirement: The project is a subsea tie-back to the Central Nexus Facility comprising two new production wells tied into Horizon South Trunkline 1 via a new subsea flowline, with production redirected for processing through Cluster 3.
requirements.why_critical: Brownfield tie-ins and rerouting through existing infrastructure introduce major interface risks, potential facility modification costs, and operational constraints that directly affect the bid estimate and schedule.
requirements.bid_team_action: Identify brownfield tie-in points at Central Nexus Facility and Cluster 3, and confirm interface battery limits and capacity availability.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_point: Specific tie-in spool dimensions, brownfield shut-down windows, and exact Brownfield modification scopes at Cluster 3 are TBD.

The selected concept is a subsea tie - back to the Central Nexus Facility , leveraging ullage in late - life infrastructure and proximity to existing manifold clusters. requirements.bid_team_action: Highlight the lack of a finalized pore pressure study as a major design risk and price corrosion-resistant tubulars based on anticipated CO₂ exposure.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_point: Absence of a finalized pore pressure study.

requirements.requirement: Hydrate risks must be mitigated through continuous injection of lean MEG solution (80% wt) with supplementary methanol injection during start-up and restart. Scale formation potential is assumed present.
requirements.why_critical: Requires the inclusion of continuous MEG injection systems, methanol dosing facilities, and scale inhibitor injection capabilities in the subsea architecture and topsides design, directly impacting cost and weight.
requirements.bid_team_action: Ensure chemical injection umbilical lines, topside storage/pumping modules, and subsea distribution units account for continuous MEG and batch methanol/scale inhibitor injection.
requirements.evidence_excerpt: 1 Reservoir Fluid Properties Given the combination of high pressure and relatively low temperature expected during both steady - state and transient operations, the reservoir fluids are predicted to be susceptible to hydrate formation. Hydrate risks will be mitigated under all scenarios through continuous injection of lean MEG solution (80% wt). A supplementary injection of methanol will be applied during start - up and restart operations to counteract low - temperature excursions and hydrat e risks. requirements.bid_team_action: Ensure all subsea block valves, manifolds, and trees are priced with material classes and wall thicknesses conforming to the stated pressure ratings and 20-year fatigue life requirements.

requirements.requirement: The subsea control system shall be fully compatible with the existing ALPINE host system, complying with COMPANY standard ENG.STA.STD.18010 and HIPPS standard ENG.STA.STD.28746, utilizing COPS communications and closed-loop hydraulics. Software updates could require temporary production shutdown.
requirements.why_critical: Incompatibility with the existing ALPINE host system or unmanaged software update constraints can lead to major offshore shutdown liabilities, costly brownfield redesigns, and delayed commissioning.
requirements.bid_team_action: Verify interface protocol compatibility with the ALPINE host system and include costs for any required topside software or hardware integration engineering.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_point: Exact software update impacts and detailed integration requirements referenced in [30] and [31] need verification.

requirements.requirement: SIMOPS and CONOPS activities during installation and commissioning may involve concurrent drilling, subsea installation, and ongoing production operations near existing facilities, requiring comprehensive risk assessments and mitigation definitions.
requirements.why_critical: Operating heavy installation and drilling equipment adjacent to live production facilities introduces major safety, regulatory exposure, and operational downtime risks that impact project schedule and execution cost.
requirements.bid_team_action: Incorporate explicit allowances for offshore SIMOPS management, safety studies, potential production throttling, and specialized offshore execution sequencing.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_point: Detailed execution rules and limitations for maintaining concurrent production during EPCI scope remain subject to further studies.
